title: Behavioral tests for AI consciousness can be gamed

statements.text: The main alternative to the theory-heavy approach is behavioral testing, but it is unreliable because AI systems can be trained to mimic human behavior while working in very different ways. Language model chat agents produce humanlike outputs while working very unlike humans, and companies have incentives to build systems that mimic humans.

sources.quote: this method is unreliable because AI systems can be trained to mimic human behaviours while working in very different ways
